# [STORY] As a service developer, I want discovery, config, gateway, and a shared library in place, so that microservices can register, externalize config, and share common code

## User Story
**As a** service developer
**I want** discovery, config, gateway and a shared library in place
**So that** microservices can register, read centralised configuration, and share common code

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a service starts, when it registers with Eureka, then it appears
      in the registry and is reachable by name (`EurekaServerIntegrationTest`)
- [x] Given a service asks for its configuration, when it calls the config
      server, then it receives per-service, per-profile content with secrets
      left as `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders (`ServedConfigurationContentTest`)
- [x] Given a request enters the platform, when it hits the gateway, then it
      is routed to the right downstream service
      (`MovieServiceContractTest`, `UserServiceContractTest`,
      `ActorServiceContractTest`, `AiServiceContractTest`)
- [x] Given a request carries an expired or malformed token, when the gateway
      handles it, then it is rejected with 401 rather than forwarded
      (`JwtUtilTest`)
- [x] Given a service needs a common type, when it depends on shared-library,
      then the data transfer objects, exceptions and utilities are available
      (six services declare it in `build.gradle`;
      `grep -l shared-library backend/*/build.gradle`)
